name: AppFlowy
description: AppFlowy is an AI-ready workspace where you can manage projects, wikis and tasks. It is an open source alternative to Notion, giving you full control of your data. This package deploys the full self-hosted AppFlowy Cloud stack: the cloud API, web client, admin console, background worker, GoTrue authentication, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis and MinIO object storage, all behind a single nginx entrypoint.
short_desc: Open source alternative to Notion. You are in charge of your data and customizations.
author: AppFlowy-IO

form_fields.label: Admin email
form_fields.hint: Email address of the initial administrator, used to sign in to the admin console at /console.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Password for the initial administrator account.

form_fields.label: Disable public sign up
form_fields.hint: Recommended. When enabled, new users can only join by invitation from the admin console.

form_fields.label: Auto confirm new users
form_fields.hint: Skip email confirmation on sign up. Disable this only if you have configured SMTP below.

form_fields.label: WebSocket scheme
form_fields.hint: Use ws when exposing AppFlowy over http, or wss when exposing it over https.

form_fields.label: SMTP host
form_fields.hint: Optional. Required for email confirmation, invitations and password recovery.

form_fields.label: SMTP username
form_fields.hint: Optional. The sender address used for outgoing email.

form_fields.label: SMTP password
form_fields.hint: Optional. Password or app password for the SMTP account.
